title: Univ4 Hooks Wizard
tagline: A wizard no code tool to combine, personnalize and build customs uniswap v4 hooks.
description: Uniswap v4 hooks are on the edge to become a DeFi revolution and extend the set of possibilities. But these technology is only accessible to solidity developers. A great amount of DeFi users and projects could enjoy an easy access to this technology. We propose a no code platform where you can build and customised hooks as well as our own rich library of hooks.
how_its_made:
First, this project forked @openzeppelin wizard contract builder. We modified and leveraged it's functionnalies to match our need and mix homemade hooks. We created 2 hooks for this. 
The swapper fee whitelist hook which will let you create a restricted access pool. The bumping fee hook, where demand for swapping is stimulated by progressively, after each swap, the fee goes back to it's initial value.
Thanks to the hook wizard, you can build a hook combining both.
